nodes.description: Internal owner address of BotProtected, later set to the deployer in ArcxToken constructor and used for privileged checks in delegate() and list().
External Ferrum bot-protection contract address; target of the low-level call performed inside the checkBots modifier.
Address of the Uniswap pair computed in the constructor and passed to the bot protection call as well as used as an allowance spender.
Public mapping holding token balances; directly mutated in transferFrom and list with unchecked arithmetic.
Public nested mapping of owner to spender allowances, written in approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Total token supply initialized to 3625000000000000000000 and used to compute the owner allocation in list().
Uniswap V2 router interface instance used by list() to add ETH liquidity.
Wrapped ETH address used for pair computation in the constructor.
Modifier that performs a low-level staticcall-style external call to botProtection with a raw selector and requires success before executing the guarded body.
Payable transfer entrypoint that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Guarded (checkBots) transfer function that updates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic and emits Transfer.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
Owner-only function that executes an arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Internal pure helper computing the Uniswap V2 pair address via CREATE2 keccak hashing.
Owner-only payable listing function that rewrites balances, adds liquidity via uniRouter with block.timestamp+600 deadline, and airdrops to a list of recipients.
Constructor setting owner = msg.sender, computing uniPair and granting infinite allowances to the router and the pair.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, allowance ownership and balance transfers.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to compute the Uniswap liquidity deadline in list().
Raw delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address executing arbitrary bytecode in the token's storage context.
Low-level .call on the attacker-configurable botProtection address executed before guarded state changes, enabling reentrancy and arbitrary code execution.
Unchecked += and -= arithmetic on balanceOf and allowance mappings without SafeMath, allowing overflow/underflow.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom used in allowance and balance arithmetic.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Target address parameter of delegate used in the delegatecall.
Calldata bytes parameter of delegate passed to the delegatecall.
Amount parameter of list controlling the contract's own balance and the ETH liquidity amount.
Array of recipient addresses in list airdrop loop.
Array of amounts in list airdrop loop.
Constructor parameter supplying the bot protection contract address.
Local variables notABot and isNotBot receiving the success flag and return data of the botProtection external call.

edges.reason: checkBots performs a low-level external call to botProtection, letting arbitrary external code execute before the guarded function body runs.
transferFrom is guarded by the checkBots modifier which makes the external call prior to any balance state mutation.
botProtection state variable is the target address of the unsafe low-level call.
uniPair state variable is passed as an argument into the bot protection external call.
msg.sender determines whether the caller is spending its own funds or must consume an allowance.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender is required to equal owner before performing the delegatecall.
msg.sender is required to equal owner before executing list.
msg.sender is used as the implicit sender in transfer.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting privileged access.
block.timestamp is used to derive the router deadline, making list timestamp dependent.
delegate executes the unsafe delegatecall with user supplied target and calldata.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf and allowance with unchecked += and -= operations.
list overwrites balanceOf entries directly without SafeMath checks.
balanceOf mapping is read and written during transferFrom.
balanceOf mapping is overwritten inside list.
allowance mapping is read and decremented inside transferFrom.
approve writes the allowance mapping entry.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom.
list calls uniRouter.addLiquidityETH using the uniRouter state variable.
totalSupply is read in list to compute the owner allocation.
uniPair is assigned in the constructor from pairFor.
wETH is used inside the constructor pair computation.
delegate target address parameter flows into the delegatecall.
delegate calldata bytes parameter flows into the delegatecall.
transfer amount parameter is used in unchecked balance arithmetic.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only used within transferFrom as the balance/allowance owner and should be folded into that function node.
_to is only used within transfer/transferFrom as the recipient and should be folded into the transferFrom function node.
_value feeds the unchecked balanceOf/allowance arithmetic and should be merged into the unsafe arithmetic operation node.
_spender is only used as the allowance key in approve and should be folded into that function node.
delegate target address parameter flows directly into the delegatecall and should merge into the unsafe operation.
delegate calldata parameter flows directly into the delegatecall and should merge into the unsafe operation.
_numList is only used within list to set balances and liquidity amounts and should be folded into the list function node.
_tos is only used within the list airdrop loop and should be folded into the list function node.
_amounts is only used within the list airdrop loop and should be folded into the list function node.
_botProtection is only consumed by the constructor chain BotProtected(_botProtection) and should be folded into the constructor node.
notABot/isNotBot are the local results of the botProtection external call inside checkBots and should be folded into that function node.
